description: Use this when the user wants a salary slip (payslip, salary slip format for India) as a PDF and Excel file from earnings and deductions they give. Put components into earnings and deductions as items ({name, amount}, or percent/of for a deduction); a simple pasted list (one name and amount per item) works as a fallback. Prorates earnings for LOP days (paid_days or lop_days, calendar or fixed-day month) or a mid-month joining, keeps bonus and reimbursements in full, and returns gross, total deductions, net pay, net pay in words (Indian and international), and download links. Does not compute PF, ESI, professional tax or TDS by law and does not take PAN, UAN or bank numbers. Do not use for salary negotiation, CTC planning or tax calculation.

basic.description: Shortcut: Basic for the full month, e.g. 25000 (same as an earnings item).

date_of_joining.description: Optional joining date, e.g. "2026-10-12" or "12/10/2026" (day first). Joining inside the pay month sets paid days when paid_days is not given.

days_in_month.description: Proration basis: "calendar" (default, 28 to 31) or a fixed number such as 30 or 26.

amount.description: Monthly amount in rupees, e.g. 25000 or "Rs 25,000". For earnings, the full-month amount before LOP.

max.description: Deductions only: optional cap on the percent amount, e.g. 1800.

of.description: Deductions only: earnings the percent applies to, e.g. "Basic" or "Basic + Dearness Allowance". Default Basic.

percent.description: Deductions only: percent of named earnings instead of an amount, e.g. 12.

prorate.description: Earnings only: false to pay in full despite LOP days (bonus, reimbursement). Default true, except bonus/arrears/reimbursement/incentive/overtime names.

deductions.description: Deductions as the user gives them: [{"name":"PF","amount":1800},{"name":"Professional Tax","amount":200},{"name":"TDS","amount":1500}], or a percent of a named earning, {"name":"PF","percent":12,"of":"Basic"}, or text "PF 12% of Basic, PT 200". Nothing is computed by law.

amount.description: Monthly amount in rupees, e.g. 25000 or "Rs 25,000". For earnings, the full-month amount before LOP.

max.description: Deductions only: optional cap on the percent amount, e.g. 1800.

of.description: Deductions only: earnings the percent applies to, e.g. "Basic" or "Basic + Dearness Allowance". Default Basic.

percent.description: Deductions only: percent of named earnings instead of an amount, e.g. 12.

prorate.description: Earnings only: false to pay in full despite LOP days (bonus, reimbursement). Default true, except bonus/arrears/reimbursement/incentive/overtime names.

earnings.description: Earnings with full-month amounts: [{"name":"Basic","amount":25000},{"name":"HRA","amount":10000},{"name":"Special Allowance","amount":8000}], or {"Basic":25000,"HRA":10000}, or text "Basic 25000, HRA 10000".

employee_name.description: Employee name as it should print, any script, e.g. "Priya Sharma" or "प्रिया शर्मा".

employer_address.description: Optional company address, e.g. "4th Floor, Tech Park, Pune 411014".

employer_name.description: Company name for the header, e.g. "Acme Technologies Pvt Ltd".

hra.description: Shortcut: HRA for the full month, e.g. 10000.

id_lines.description: true to print blank PAN, UAN and bank account lines to fill by hand. These numbers are not collected.

last_working_day.description: Optional last working day inside the pay month, e.g. "2026-10-20", for a final slip.

lop_days.description: Loss-of-pay days, e.g. 2. Paid days = days in month - LOP days.

month.description: Pay month, e.g. "October 2026" or "2026-10". Default: last month.

paid_days.description: Days paid, e.g. 28 or 29.5. Default: all days of the month (or days from joining).

pf.description: Shortcut: PF deduction amount, e.g. 1800, or "12%" (of Basic).

professional_tax.description: Shortcut: professional tax deduction as given, e.g. 200.

rounding.description: "rupee" (default, prorated amounts to the nearest rupee) or "paise".

special_allowance.description: Shortcut: Special Allowance for the full month, e.g. 8000.

tds.description: Shortcut: TDS deduction as given, e.g. 1500.

name: generate_salary_slip
title: Generate salary slip
